channel.name: Channel
channel.description: The Twitch channel whose chat is shown. Leave empty to use the Twitch account linked on laby.net.

autoConnect.name: Connect automatically
autoConnect.description: Join the channel as soon as the game starts.

startLogin.name: Log in with Twitch
startLogin.description: Needed to write messages. Reading works without an account.

showInChatTab.name: Own chat tab
showInChatTab.description: Shows the Twitch chat as its own tab in the chat window. Messages you type while that tab is open are sent to Twitch.

mirrorToMainChat.name: Also show in the main chat
mirrorToMainChat.description: Copies every Twitch message into the regular chat with a [Twitch] prefix.

showBadges.name: Badges
showBadges.description: Broadcaster, moderator, VIP and subscriber badges in front of the name.

thirdPartyEmotes.name: BTTV and FFZ emotes
thirdPartyEmotes.description: Also renders BetterTTV and FrankerFaceZ emotes of the channel.

showEvents.name: Channel events
showEvents.description: Subscriptions, raids, timeouts and other channel notices.

highlightMentions.name: Highlight mentions
highlightMentions.description: Highlights messages that mention your Twitch or Minecraft name.

twitch_chat.name: Twitch Chat
twitch_chat.description: Shows the newest Twitch chat messages while you play.

hideAfter.name: Hide after (seconds)
hideAfter.description: 0 keeps the messages until new ones arrive.

commands.help: /twitch join <channel> | leave | connect | login | logout | status | say <message>  -  /tw <message> writes into the channel

messages.resolvingChannel: No channel set, looking up your linked Twitch account...
messages.noChannel: No channel configured. Set one in the settings or use /twitch join <channel>.
messages.readOnly: Read-only mode. Log in via the settings or /twitch login to write messages.
messages.loginRequired: You need to log in with Twitch to write messages (/twitch login).
messages.notConnected: Not connected to a Twitch channel.
messages.sendFailed: The message could not be sent.
messages.noClientId: No Twitch client id configured. Enter one in the advanced settings.
messages.loginPending: A login is already in progress. Finish it in your browser.
messages.loginExpired: The login code expired. Start the login again.
messages.sessionExpired: Your Twitch session expired. Please log in again.
messages.authFailed: Twitch rejected the login. Please log in again.
messages.chatCleared: The chat was cleared by a moderator.
